discrepancies: DVM DC 0.002 V at 0.01 V/div, offset 0 V (pp. 84-85): printed 0.00042 .. 0.00442, specification gives -0.00042 .. 0.00442
DC offset 100 V at 1.01 V/div (p. 60): printed 98.80 .. 101.2, specification gives 98.798 .. 101.202
Random noise, 1 GHz instruments, CH4 Full BW (p. 64): printed 3.4 mV (CH1-CH3 3.1 mV); specification p. 19: 3.1 mV. Printed value applied.
DVM DC, 2 mV input (pp. 84-85): printed low limit 0.00042 V; specification p. 46 gives -0.00042 V. CORRECTED to -0.00042 V (visible note on the point).
DVM AC, 5 V p-p at 1 V/div (pp. 86-87): printed 2.450 mV / 2.550 mV; 2.5 V rms +/-2 % = 2.450 V / 2.550 V. CORRECTED to volts (visible note).
DC balance procedure (p. 92 step 8) names a 150 MHz bandwidth limit; the test record and the specification (p. 15) use 250 MHz. 250 MHz used.
DC offset procedure (p. 101) sets 900 mV at 1 mV/div; the test record prints 700 mV. 700 mV used.
DC offset 1.01 V/div, +/-100 V (p. 60): specification p. 14 gives +/-1.202 V (0.2 div x 1.01 V/div); printed +/-1.2 V (98.80 / 101.2 V) applied.
DC gain (p. 97-98): the procedure measures at 50 Ω first and repeats at 1 MΩ; the test record lists 1 MΩ only (no 50 Ω rows or limits). 1 MΩ only built.

Bandwidth worksheet (pp. 95-96): no 10 mV/div row for 500 / 350 / 200 / 100 MHz instruments and two 1 mV/div rows (150 MHz, 100 MHz) for 200 MHz; the specification (p. 15) frequencies are used (see the notes on the points).
TPA DANL (p. 82): "50 kHz - 1 GHz (3-SA3 not installed)"; procedure p. 120 checks 5 MHz - 1 GHz. 5 MHz used.
Residual spurs (p. 80): the "5 MHz to 2 GHz (not 1.25 GHz)" row has no 3-SA3 qualifier; the procedure (p. 113) checks 5 MHz - 1 GHz without 3-SA3 and 5 MHz - 2 GHz with it. Built as the procedure.
DANL 2 GHz to 3 GHz (p. 112 step 8d): the centre frequency is printed as 1.5 GHz, outside the 2 GHz to 3 GHz range; 2.5 GHz used (owner decision 2026-10-25, visible note on the point).
DANL with the TPA-N-PRE (pp. 120-121): the centre frequency is not printed ("the center frequency"); the DANL procedure's centres are used (note on the points).

DVM frequency 150 MHz (p. 88): printed +/-10 kHz; specification p. 46 (+/-(10 uHz/Hz + 1 count)) gives +/-11.5 kHz. Printed (tighter) limit applied. Specification p. 46: counter maximum 100 MHz for 100 MHz models - the 150 MHz point is not run on them.
